#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 1000000007LL;

class FastReader {
public:
    FastReader() {
        ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
        cin.tie(nullptr);
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        return x;
    }
    
    long long nextLong() {
        long long x;
        cin >> x;
        return x;
    }
};

ll gcd(ll a, ll b) {
    return a == 0 ? b : (b > a ? gcd(b % a, a) : gcd(b, a));
}

int main() {
    FastReader in;
    int n = in.nextInt();
    
    vector<ll> dp(2 * n + 1, 0);
    dp[0] = 1;
    ll result = 0;
    
    for (int p = 1; p <= 2 * n; ++p) {
        vector<ll> ndp(2 * n + 1, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * n; ++i) {
            if (dp[i] != 0) {
                ndp[i + 1] = (ndp[i + 1] + dp[i]) % MOD;
                if (i - 1 >= 0) {
                    ndp[i - 1] = (ndp[i - 1] + dp[i]) % MOD;
                    if (p % 2 == 0 && (2 * n - p) >= i - 1) {
                        result = (result + dp[i]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        dp = move(ndp);
    }
    
    cout << result % MOD << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
